import html # Template for the user profile; placeholders are marked with {name}, {bio}, and {status} PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{bio}

{status}
""" def generate_user_profile(username: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Render a user's profile information safely for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as they entered it. biography : str A user‑written biography that may span multiple sentences. status : str A brief, current status message provided by the user. Returns ------- str The profile HTML string with all user input properly escaped to prevent injection attacks (CWE‑74). """ # Escape all user-provided content to neutralize special HTML characters safe_name = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format(name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status)
